description: The multiple alignment of the T-Coffee 13.41 program (t_coffee; Notredame, Higgins & Heringa 2000) reproduced end to end: its own primary library built by the program's pair-wise methods - 'proba_pair' (the program's default: ProbCons pair-HMM posteriors > 0.01, at most 4 x min(length) pairs per pair of sequences), 'slow_pair' (Myers-Miller global alignment, dna_idmat 10 / 0 with gap open -10 / extend -1 for DNA, BLOSUM62 for proteins) and 'lalign_id_pair' (Huang-Miller SIM, the lalignTopAlignments best non-intersecting local alignments), several methods merged the way the program's forked library merge does (which is not their union) - then library relaxation, the program's guide tree (k-tuple distances, neighbour joining with the trifurcating root turned into a binary tree; fast neighbour joining from 100 sequences) and the sparse linked-pair-wise progressive stage. Rows equal t_coffee -seq s.fa [-method m1,m2] -output fasta_aln on 1 500+ committed DNA and protein sets (libraries pair by pair on 800+ more), for any -n_core. The type (DNA when more than 98 % of the letters are A G C T U N R Y M K S W H B V D, otherwise protein) selects the matrices, penalties and models. RNA input (a U) uses the program's separate RNA pair-HMM (5 matrix types, 2 insert state pairs, get_tot_prob). Further command-line options of the program are accepted in 'options' (a t_coffee flag string, e.g. '-tree_mode upgma -distance_matrix_mode fast -seq_weight t_coffee -relax_lib 2 -filter_lib 20 -gapopen -50 -gapext -2 -nomatch 5 -outorder aligned'): -relax_lib N, -filter_lib T, -tree_mode nj|upgma (cwph, kmeans and unknown names are the program's refusals: TCoffeeAbortedException), -distance_matrix_mode ktup|fast|idscore|no (aln, ktup2 and unknown names are refused as the program does; slow / cscore / clustalw / geometric are not ported yet), -distance_matrix_sim_mode (idmat_sim1/2/3, gap1, logid), -seq_weight t_coffee|no|@w1,w2,... (weights in input order), -weight no, -gapopen, -gapext, -cosmetic_penalty, -nomatch, -do_normalise, -inorder aligned|input, -outorder input|aligned, -lalign_n_top, -method; flags without influence on the rows (-extend_mode, -evaluate_mode, -shrink_lib, -tg_mode, -ktuple, -n_core, ...) are accepted and ignored; any other flag is rejected by name. Every option is verified row for row against the installed t_coffee on 150+ committed sets (4 300+ sets in all). 'names' = the sequence names: the program sorts the sequences by name (strcmp order) before building the library and the tree (-inorder aligned, its default) and restores the input order on output, which is the 'name-prefix quirk' (s1 / s10 trees differ); without names the names are taken to sort in input order. -matrix NAME (38 matrices of the program: blosum30..80mt, pam120..350mt, md_*, idmat, est_idmat, ...). Further pair-wise methods (audit A2-3 / A2-4): 'biphasic_pair' (biphasic_pair_wise: two affine gap models, opening x 2 / extension / 2 and opening / 2 / extension x 2), 'lalign_rs_s_pair' (lalign_id_pair on every pair INCLUDING each sequence against itself), 'promo_pair' / 'blastr_pair' (slow_pair on the dinucleotide-extended alphabet, matrices promoter_tf1 / blosumR, gap open -60 / -20; the program's shared sequence array is changed lossily by the extension, which is reproduced); -distance_matrix_sim_mode also accepts the group names of make_group_aa (simple, mafft, clustalw, polarity, vasiliky, make_all, an unknown name = no group) and idscore (a gap in the first row of an aligned pair under -distance_matrix_mode fast makes the program segfault, exit status 11). A set on which the program itself dies - lalign_id_pair with a very small gap open (e.g. 'lalign_id_pair@EP@GOP@-3': SIM's edit-script array overflows its heap chunk), the methods clean_slow_pair / hash_pair / subop1_pair / subop2_pair / cfast_pair, the idscore segfault - raises TCoffeeAbortedException (ExitStatus, Reason). totalScore is the natural affine sum of pairs (EDNAFULL / BLOSUM62), not the program's objective.

sequences.description: Sequences to align (at least one, none empty): letters only (the program removes gaps; here they are rejected).

methods.description: Primary-library methods in command-line order (t_coffee -method m1,m2): 'proba_pair' (default; = plain t_coffee seqs.fa), 'slow_pair', 'lalign_id_pair', 'clustalw_pair' (the ClustalW 2.1 pair alignments), 'biphasic_pair', 'lalign_rs_s_pair', 'promo_pair', 'blastr_pair', each optionally with the program's parameter overrides, e.g. 'slow_pair@EP@GOP@-30@GEP@-3@MATRIX@blosum50mt'; 'clean_slow_pair', 'hash_pair', 'subop1_pair', 'subop2_pair', 'cfast_pair' are refused by the program itself and raise TCoffeeAbortedException.

lalignTopAlignments.description: t_coffee -lalign_n_top (default 10): alignments reported by lalign_id_pair for every pair of sequences.

type.description: 'auto' (default; the program's decision), 'dna' or 'protein' (forces the matrices, penalties and models).

options.description: Further t_coffee flags, e.g. '-tree_mode upgma -relax_lib 2 -seq_weight t_coffee -gapext -2' (see the tool description for the supported list); applied after the other parameters.

names.description: Sequence names (one per sequence, in input order): the program sorts the sequences by name before computing anything (-inorder aligned); omitted = names that sort in input order.

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA (input order).

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a residue beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Natural affine sum-of-pairs score of the alignment (BLOSUM62 10 / 0.2 for proteins, EDNAFULL 10 / 0.5 for nucleotides; MUSCLE itself reports no such score).

errors.message: a sequence is empty or contains a character other than a letter

methods must be proba_pair, slow_pair or lalign_id_pair; type must be auto, dna or protein; lalignTopAlignments must be at least 1; options contains a t_coffee flag or value that is not supported (named in the message); names does not have one entry per sequence

examples.name: Five related protein sequences, the program's default (`t_coffee seqs.fa` = proba_pair)
